title: Eval holdout set: 50 questions, ~12.5% of corrections corpus
body: The evaluation holdout set (out/eval/eval.jsonl) contains 50 questions, selected via sha1 mod 8 deterministic sampling (approximately 12.5% of records). This set is strictly held out and never enters training (SFT or DPO). Format: ChatML with system prompt + user question + expected assistant response.
